result.title: Branch and Consolidate: A Unified Recipe for Multi-Teacher On-Policy Distillation
result.summary: Specialists post-trained from a shared checkpoint acquire complementary capabilities, and multi-teacher on-policy distillation (MOPD) can consolidate them into a single model. However, we find that existing consolidation methods, from weight merging to MOPD, fall short when specialists diverge substantially from the shared checkpoint, whereas prior studies mostly examine specialists that remain close to it. We present a unified recipe for multimodal MOPD that consolidates such specialists back into the single student they branched from. The recipe specifies initialization, data selection, balanced supervision across teachers, and preservation of existing capabilities for consolidation, together with a targeted refinement stage for capabilities that still lag behind their specialists. In an industrial setting with six specialists, the student closely approaches each specialist in its own domain and surpasses the perception specialist. It recovers 97.0% of their average gain, compared with 79.8% for IM-MOPD. In the fully open five-domain setting with Qwen3-4B, our method recovers 95.7% of the specialists' average gain after consolidation and 97.5% after refinement, compared with 94.1% for IM-MOPD. We further analyze the full pipeline through mechanism ablations and training dynamics, providing practical guidance for diagnosing incomplete consolidation. Code will be released.

AI.brief_summary: 论文研究多教师 on-policy 蒸馏（MOPD）如何把从共享 checkpoint 分叉出的多个多模态专家合并回单一学生模型，提出涵盖初始化、数据选择、跨教师均衡监督与既有能力保持的统一配方，并增加针对性精炼阶段，在工业六专家与开放五领域设定下验证。
AI.relevance_reason: 论文不涉及 latent 推理状态，但其跨教师均衡监督、能力保持与「合并不完全」诊断思路，可能为 LVR 训练中的多源推理行为监督与能力保留提供可核查线索。
